scope: Mainland Portugal OSM toll booth/gantry candidates, not verified active tariffs or graph bindings
limitations: Charge nodes may remain after toll abolition; presence is not proof of a charge
Unnamed plazas cannot be assigned official station IDs by guessing
OSM names alone do not certify graph edge traversal or tariff entry/exit
Counts describe directed lane/way records, not unique charging stations
No GPS, graph geometry or navigation algorithms were changed
